description: What `quantity` units cost at each provider selling `type`, cheapest first; the same as GET /api/v1/quote. quantity counts GB for per_gb, IPs for per_ip, ports for per_port, thousands of requests for per_request, ports or plans for unlimited; per_ip, per_port and unlimited are priced for `months` months of monthly billing (quarterly or yearly billing too when months is a multiple of 3 or 12). Default pricing_model is the type's usual one (per_gb for residential and mobile, per_ip for datacenter and ISP). Graduated ladders are summed band by band; trial and once-only offers are never used. ip_version (default ipv4 for datacenter and ISP, where tiers without an IP version count as IPv4; any for residential and mobile) and shared (default any) choose which tiers count, and providers with no matching tier are left out (see warnings). Each quote names the tier used with its ip_version and shared; estimate: true means no usable price ladder (price_from_usd × quantity, a lower bound). List prices in USD, excluding taxes and promotions: confirm on the provider's site.

ip_version.description: Which tiers to price: ipv4 (tiers without an IP version count as IPv4), ipv6 or any. Default ipv4 for datacenter and isp, any for residential and mobile.

months.description: For per_ip, per_port and unlimited: months of service (default 1); multiples of 3 or 12 also use quarterly or yearly prices. Ignored for per_gb and per_request.

pricing_model.description: Default: the usual model for the type.

quantity.description: Units to buy, in the pricing model's unit (whole numbers for per_ip, per_port and unlimited).

shared.description: true: shared IPs only; false: dedicated IPs only; "any" (default): every tier. Tiers that do not say whether they are shared match only "any".
